description: This file implements middleware for admin JWT authentication in an Express.js application. It verifies the presence and validity of a Bearer token in the request headers, ensuring the token belongs to an admin, and attaches admin info to the request object.

methods.name: adminAuth(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that authenticates admin users via JWT token and attaches their info to the request object.
